import boto3

def summarize_text(text):
    comprehend = boto3.client('comprehend')
    summary = comprehend.summarize_text(
        LanguageCode='en',
        Text=text,
        SummarizationType='BASIC'
    )
    return summary['Summary']

if __name__ == '__main__':
    text = 'Your document text goes here.'
    summary = summarize_text(text)
    print(summary)

import boto3

def conditional_update(table_name, key, update_expression, expression_attribute_values, expected_version):
    dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
    table = dynamodb.Table(table_name)

    response = table.update_item(
        Key=key,
        UpdateExpression=update_expression,
        ExpressionAttributeValues=expression_attribute_values,
        Expected={'version': {'Value': expected_version, 'Exists': True}}
    )

    return response

import boto3

def query_documents(table_name, key, value):
    dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
    table = dynamodb.Table(table_name)
    response = table.query(
        KeyConditionExpression=boto3.dynamodb.conditions.Key(key).eq(value)
    )
    return response['Items']
